about: A server that stores and shows the locations sent by the OwnTracks phone apps.

prs.title: CSV exports keep every value in its own column
prs.broken: The CSV export took its header from the first location, so later rows with different fields shifted into the wrong columns.
prs.changed: The header now covers every field in the export, and each row fills its own columns, leaving blanks where a field is missing.
prs.matters: Location history exported to CSV opens correctly in spreadsheets.
